title: The Orkut scrapbook ritual
description: A new scrap from a friend could make your whole day. Communities, testimonials and carefully chosen profile songs made the internet feel like a neighbourhood.
sourceTitle: Orkut is dead, but in India the memories live on

title: The cyber-café hour
description: A small pocket of internet time: crowded computer rows, hourly billing, Yahoo Messenger logins and the race to check everything before the timer ran out.
sourceTitle: 20 years on: India’s cyber cafes disappearing as pocket internet takes over

title: The precious SMS pack
description: Before every message was free, each text counted. Friends invented abbreviations, forwarded jokes and timed calls around the cheapest recharge offers.
sourceTitle: Small talk's big business for cellular companies

title: Everyone had an Indian Idol favourite
description: Reality TV turned the living room into a voting booth. School friends campaigned for their pick, argued over performances and waited for the results together.

title: The first IPL season changed match nights
description: City jerseys, auction drama and a new fast-paced cricket format made it easy for families and friend groups to pick a side beyond the national team.

title: FarmVille requests in your feed
description: For a while, tending a tiny virtual farm was a daily ritual. Friends swapped gifts, asked for help and discovered that social games could turn a feed into a hangout.
sourceTitle: Facebook and Zynga Enter Into Long-Term Relationship

title: One more try at Angry Birds
description: A quick mobile game became the universal way to pass a bus ride, wait for a friend or borrow someone's phone between classes.
sourceTitle: Angry Birds Celebrates 10 years of Popping Piggies & Using Anger for Good

title: Why this Kolaveri Di?
description: A playful song crossed language and regional lines, spreading through shares and covers. Suddenly everyone had an opinion on the soup song.

title: The Gangnam Style dance break
description: The horse-riding dance travelled from YouTube screens to school functions, weddings and friend-group performances across the country.

title: The family group chat begins
description: As smartphones spread, WhatsApp made photos, jokes and family updates feel instant. Soon every cousin group had its own good-morning routine.
sourceTitle: WhatsApp announces 400 million monthly active users

title: Mobile data suddenly felt limitless
description: Cheaper mobile data changed what people did on the go: more video, more sharing and more of everyday life moving online.
sourceTitle: Reliance Jio 4G services launched, to be fully free till end of 2016

title: Short videos found their Indian voices
description: Creators made quick performances, jokes and local-language videos for people far beyond the big cities. The format became a launchpad for new talent.
sourceTitle: Here's What Happened When India Banned TikTok

title: Ludo became the family video call
description: During lockdown, a familiar board game helped friends and relatives spend time together from separate homes. Old rivalries came back online.
